_about: Local fixture panel. NOT a database, and never reported as one: the
retriever marks anything sourced here LOCAL_FIXTURE.
Audited and corrected. Three entries were wrong in ways that would have
produced confidently wrong downstream analysis:
IGF1     held a 33-residue sequence sharing not one 6-mer with mature
IGF-1. It was not the mature peptide, the precursor, or a
fragment of either. Replaced with the canonical 70-residue
mature chain.
INS      held the 21-residue insulin A-chain under the name of insulin,
which is a two-chain 51-residue molecule. The sequence was
right and the label was wrong; the entry now says which it is.
BPC157   held a 53-residue sequence that contradicts the 15-residue
BPC-157 in reference_peptides.json and does not contain it.
Its provenance could not be established, so it is flagged for
verification rather than guessed at.
Also removed: `known_var_effects`, which carried a position-6 L->I claim
at confidence 0.8 with no citation. Mature IGF-1 has cysteine at position
6, nothing in the codebase read the field, and an uncited numeric
confidence is exactly what this project refuses to emit.
The `homologs` lists each held one distinct sequence repeated, so the
conservation gate correctly declined to compute entropy from them. They
are empty now and say why, rather than looking like retrieved alignments.

IGF1.function: IGF-1 receptor binding, growth promotion, mitogenic signaling
IGF1.homolog_note: No verified orthologue sequences are bundled. Conservation is reported as not computed rather than computed over copies of the query.

INS.function: The A chain of insulin. Insulin itself is a two-chain, 51-residue molecule; this chain alone is not insulin and does not bind the insulin receptor on its own.
INS.homolog_note: No verified orthologue sequences are bundled.

GCG.function: Counter-regulatory hormone: raises blood glucose via the glucagon receptor
GCG.homolog_note: No verified orthologue sequences are bundled.

BPC157.full_name: Unverified sequence previously filed under BPC-157
BPC157.verification_note: This 53-residue sequence contradicts the 15-residue BPC-157 recorded in reference_peptides.json (GEPPPGKPADDAGLV) and does not contain it. It may be a fragment of the gastric juice protein BPC from which BPC-157 derives, but that was not established. It is retained, flagged, and given no function annotation rather than being deleted or relabelled on a guess.
BPC157.homolog_note: No verified orthologue sequences are bundled.
